facts.fact: OpenAI's GPT-5.3-Codex model is listed with an input price of $1.75 per 1M text tokens.
OpenAI's GPT-5.3-Codex model is listed with a cached input price of $0.175 per 1M text tokens.
OpenAI's GPT-5.3-Codex model is listed with an output price of $14.00 per 1M text tokens.
OpenAI lists GPT-5.3-Codex with a 400,000-token context window.
OpenAI lists GPT-5.3-Codex with a maximum output of 128,000 tokens.
OpenAI lists the knowledge cutoff for GPT-5.3-Codex as August 31, 2025.
OpenAI's page labels GPT-5.3-Codex as deprecated.
GPT-5.3-Codex supports reasoning effort settings low, medium, high, and xhigh.
facts.quote: GPT-5.3-Codex supports `low`, `medium`, `high`, and `xhigh` reasoning effort settings.

facts.fact: GPT-5.3-Codex accepts text and image input and produces text output; audio and video are not supported.
facts.quote:
Audio

Not supported

Video

Not supported

facts.fact: GPT-5.3-Codex's rate limit for the Build usage tier is 5,000 RPM and 1,000,000 TPM, with a batch queue limit of 3,000,000.
GPT-5.3-Codex's rate limit for the Launch usage tier is 10,000 RPM and 4,000,000 TPM, with a batch queue limit of 200,000,000.
GPT-5.3-Codex's rate limit for the Grow usage tier is 15,000 RPM and 40,000,000 TPM, with a batch queue limit of 15,000,000,000.
OpenAI's page states that the Free usage tier does not support GPT-5.3-Codex.
